newsitem.title: USA: Albany, NY official objects to airport deal's fees.
newsitem.headline: Albany, NY official objects to airport deal's fees.

text.p: The Albany County, N.Y., comptroller, who has derailed a $100 million bond sale for Albany Airport, objected to the $1.1 million in underwriting fees, the Daily Gazette said Tuesday.
The paper said Michael Conners was given the fee estimate after six weeks of requests, and quoted his attorney, Kevin Luibrand as saying that they were too high.
"They are probably standard, but the problem is that these kinds of transactions have gone on in secret forever," Luibrand told the paper.

Without the bond sale, the airport authority is expected to run out of money in mid-February, when it no longer will be able to pay construction workers, halting work on a new passenger terminal slated to open in October 1998, the paper said.

The Albany comptroller wants the airport to sell the bonds on a competitive basis, instead of through negotiation, but the airport officials have said that would be more costly as this would be its first issue.
H. Carl McCall, the state comptroller, has approved selling the bonds by negotiation.
The paper offered the following breakdown of fees involved in the deal.

--$525,000 to $625,000 to Lehman Brothers, the book-running syndicate manager, and four other investment banks. Other firms involved in the deal include First Albany Corp, Pryor, McClendon, Counts & Co, which the paper listed as underwriters, and M.R. Beal & Co and J.P. Morgan Securities as co-managing underwriters.
--$125,000 to $150,000 in management fees for the investment bankers, based on how many bonds they sell.
--$70,000 to $80,000 for the bond underwriting law firm, Hiscock and Barclay of Albany.
--$90,000 to $125,000 for the authority's outside bond law firm, Hawkins and Delafield.
--$70,000 to $90,000 for the airport's consulting firm, Aviation Planning Associates, for a feasibility study.
--$70,000 to $80,000 for various expenses, including travel, printing and other services.
